#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
const ll INF = LLONG_MAX / 4;

struct Edge;
struct Node {
    int index;
    vector<Edge*> edges;
    Node() : index(-1) {}
};

struct Edge {
    bool forward;
    Node *from, *to;
    ll flow, capacity, cost;
    Edge *dual;
    Edge(Node *s, Node *d, ll cap, bool f) : forward(f), from(s), to(d), flow(0), capacity(cap), cost(0), dual(nullptr) {}
    ll remaining() const { return capacity - flow; }
    void addFlow(ll amount) {
        flow += amount;
        dual->flow -= amount;
    }
};

class MaxFlowSolver {
public:
    vector<Node> nodes;
    MaxFlowSolver(int n = 0) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) addNode();
    }
    Node* addNode() {
        nodes.emplace_back();
        Node* n = &nodes.back();
        n->index = nodes.size() - 1;
        return n;
    }
    void link(Node *n1, Node *n2, ll capacity, ll cost = 1) {
        Edge *e12 = new Edge(n1, n2, capacity, true);
        Edge *e21 = new Edge(n2, n1, 0, false);
        e12->dual = e21;
        e21->dual = e12;
        e12->cost = cost;
        e21->cost = -cost;
        n1->edges.push_back(e12);
        n2->edges.push_back(e21);
    }
    void link(int n1, int n2, ll capacity) {
        link(&nodes[n1], &nodes[n2], capacity);
    }
    virtual ll getMaxFlow(Node *src, Node *snk) = 0;
};

class MinCostMaxFlowSolver : public MaxFlowSolver {
public:
    MinCostMaxFlowSolver(int n = 0) : MaxFlowSolver(n) {}
    virtual pair<ll,ll> getMinCostMaxFlow(Node *src, Node *snk) = 0;
};

class EdmondsKarp : public MinCostMaxFlowSolver {
public:
    EdmondsKarp(int n = 0) : MinCostMaxFlowSolver(n) {}
    pair<ll,ll> getMinCostMaxFlow(Node *src, Node *snk) override {
        ll maxflow = getMaxFlow(src, snk);
        return {maxflow, minCost};
    }
private:
    ll minCost;
    struct Item {
        ll dist;
        int v;
        Item(ll d, int vv) : dist(d), v(vv) {}
        bool operator>(const Item& other) const { return dist > other.dist; }
    };
public:
    ll getMaxFlow(Node *src, Node *snk) override {
        int n = nodes.size();
        int source = src->index;
        int sink = snk->index;
        ll flow = 0;
        ll cost = 0;
        vector<ll> potential(n, 0);
        while (true) {
            vector<Edge*> parent(n, nullptr);
            vector<ll> dist(n, INF);
            dist[source] = 0;
            priority_queue<Item, vector<Item>, greater<Item>> pq;
            pq.push(Item(0, source));
            while (!pq.empty()) {
                Item item = pq.top(); pq.pop();
                if (item.dist != dist[item.v]) continue;
                Node* cur = &nodes[item.v];
                for (Edge* e : cur->edges) {
                    ll temp = dist[item.v] + e->cost + potential[item.v] - potential[e->to->index];
                    if (e->capacity > e->flow && dist[e->to->index] > temp) {
                        dist[e->to->index] = temp;
                        parent[e->to->index] = e;
                        pq.push(Item(temp, e->to->index));
                    }
                }
            }
            if (parent[sink] == nullptr) break;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
                if (parent[i] != nullptr) potential[i] += dist[i];
            ll augFlow = INF;
            for (int i = sink; i != source; i = parent[i]->from->index)
                augFlow = min(augFlow, parent[i]->capacity - parent[i]->flow);
            for (int i = sink; i != source; i = parent[i]->from->index) {
                Edge* e = parent[i];
                e->addFlow(augFlow);
                cost += augFlow * e->cost;
            }
            flow += augFlow;
        }
        minCost = cost;
        return flow;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int N, M, K, C, D;
    cin >> N >> M >> K >> C >> D;
    EdmondsKarp solver;
    vector<int> people(K);
    for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
        cin >> people[i];
        people[i]--;
    }
    Node* src = solver.addNode();
    Node* snk = solver.addNode();
    int amt = 150;
    vector<Node*> timeNodes(N * amt);
    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j < amt; j++) {
            int idx = i * amt + j;
            timeNodes[idx] = solver.addNode();
            if (j > 1) {
                solver.link(timeNodes[i * amt + (j - 1)], timeNodes[idx], INF, 0);
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
        solver.link(src, timeNodes[people[i] * amt + 1], 1, 0);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i < amt; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < K; j++) {
            solver.link(timeNodes[0 * amt + i], snk, 1, C * i - C);
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
        int a, b;
        cin >> a >> b;
        a--; b--;
        for (int j = 1; j < amt - 1; j++) {
            ll prev = 0;
            for (int k = 1; k <= K; k++) {
                ll cost = D * k * k - prev;
                solver.link(timeNodes[a * amt + j], timeNodes[b * amt + (j + 1)], 1, cost);
                solver.link(timeNodes[b * amt + j], timeNodes[a * amt + (j + 1)], 1, cost);
                prev = D * k * k;
            }
        }
    }
    auto ret = solver.getMinCostMaxFlow(src, snk);
    cout << ret.second << "\n";
    return 0;
}
